card.name: Software download and man-page footers
card.fires_on: Words inside software instructions or documentation footers, such as 'Double click the ... .jar file to run the program' and 'Generated by dwww version ... on'. It is not about drug labels.

modes.label: Run-the-program instructions
modes.description: Words in a sentence telling the reader to double click a Java archive file and run the program.

modes.label: Man-page footer text
modes.description: Words in Linux man-page colophon or dwww generator lines.

card.writes: It lowers software and simulator words such as 'simulator', 'software' and '软件' as next words.
card.plain: It marks computer program instructions and Linux manual page footers, where the next word is unlikely to be 'software' or 'simulator'.
